If it fails to restore usable access, conditional creation of one nonspending operating account is distinct from Merchant claim migration, tracking changes, owner-only billing/verification and paid launch. Actual signed-in/app access, policy state, newer tag destination, current claim holder, old exposure and purchase reconciliation remain unresolved. Fifteen minutes elapsed is not evidence resolving any of them.
Shopify publication or old feed rows do not establish Merchant acceptance or current product profitability. Historical campaign outcomes are not new-account learning or an approved template.
No live identity, billing, MFA, policy, tracking, ownership migration, campaign or financial action was performed or newly authorized by this review.
Current direct owner steering is honored without repeating a general approval request; it does not remove financial/platform restrictions or current paid-control gates.
